preconditions.description: Input S is a non-empty string with length between 1 and 5 (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: all(len(p) == len(S) for p in return_value) and all(all(c in S for c in p) for p in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every string in the returned list is a permutation of S (same length and contains exactly the same characters with the same multiplicities).

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == len(set(S)) ** len(S) // math.prod(math.factorial([S.count(c) for c in set(S)])) if len(set(S)) > 0 else 1
postconditions.description: The returned list contains all unique permutations of S, accounting for duplicate characters (i.e., the number of distinct permutations is n! / (product of factorials of counts of each duplicate character)).
The returned list is sorted lexicographically.

postconditions.expression: all(p1 != p2 for i, p1 in enumerate(return_value) for p2 in return_value[i+1:])
postconditions.description: All permutations in the returned list are unique (no duplicates).
